definitions.explanation: The act of showing contempt or disrespect toward something sacred, revered, or deeply valued. Can refer to religious blasphemy or more broadly to treating something precious with disrespect.

examples.japanese: {神|かみ}への{冒涜|ぼうとく}だ。
{死者|ししゃ}を{冒涜|ぼうとく}するような{行為|こうい}は{許|ゆる}されない。
examples.english: Acts that desecrate the dead are unforgivable.

examples.japanese: あの{発言|はつげん}は{芸術|げいじゅつ}に{対|たい}する{冒涜|ぼうとく}であり、{多|おお}くの{批判|ひはん}を{浴|あ}びた。
examples.english: That remark was a desecration of art and drew much criticism.

notes:
A strong, serious word expressing contempt or violation of something sacred or highly valued. While it can refer to religious blasphemy, in Japanese it is more broadly applied to any act that profanes or degrades something considered important — the memory of the dead, art, human dignity, or cherished traditions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冒涜|ぼうとく}する — to blaspheme, to desecrate
- {神|かみ}への{冒涜|ぼうとく} — blasphemy against God
- {人権|じんけん}の{冒涜|ぼうとく} — an affront to human rights
- {冒涜的|ぼうとくてき}な — blasphemous, sacrilegious

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {侮辱|ぶじょく} — insult, affront; directed at a person's dignity rather than something sacred
- {不敬|ふけい} — disrespect, irreverence; showing lack of proper respect, lighter than {冒涜|ぼうとく}
- {汚|けが}す — to defile, to pollute; a verb meaning to make something impure
